edges.reason: msg.sender is returned as the caller identity used by all authorization checks.
transfer moves funds from the caller-derived account.
approve uses the caller-derived owner account.
transferFrom spends the caller allowance via _msgSender.
_approve writes allowances and flag mappings keyed by the caller.
_transfer receives _msgSender as the sender account.
Deployer address becomes creator and privileged flag holder.
Deployer is passed as creator to the token constructor.
block.timestamp is the entropy used by the pseudo-random generator.
block.timestamp flows directly into keccak256 pseudo-randomness.
randomly(16000) is used as divisor for a balance, enabling zero-division or value wipe.
_approve divides _balances[owner] by a pseudo-random divisor when SerWTF is set.
_InitiateProtection executes the destructive balance division loop.
Balance storage is read and overwritten by the division operation.
_InitiateProtection calls randomly to obtain the loop condition and divisor.
_transfer invokes the frontrunner protection check before moving funds.
_transfer invokes _InitiateProtection after the checks.
Frontrunner protection can execute require(false) or an unmeetable cap check.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer core.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer core.
transferFrom decreases the allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_approve stores the allowance amount.
_approve may flip DemocraticContract[spender] to true for the creator.
_approve writes NationalContract[spender].
_approve may clear the one-shot BigNationalContract gate.
_approve may rewrite _balances[owner] through the SerWTF branch.
_transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient balance.
_transfer may set DemocraticContract[recipient] for creator transfers.
_transfer pushes every recipient into chinaArray, growing unbounded state.
_transfer may overwrite the CapitalContract transfer cap.
_transfer toggles the HelloMrSer flag for creator transfers.
_frontrunnerProtection reads the CapitalContract cap.
_frontrunnerProtection reads the DemocraticContract exemption flag.
_frontrunnerProtection reads the NationalFlair threshold.
_InitiateProtection sets SerWTF to true once triggered.
_InitiateProtection reads and rewrites DemocraticContract flags.
_InitiateProtection iterates chinaArray, making gas cost grow over time.
randomly stores the computed value into Checkmate.
Checkmate is returned as the pseudo-random result.
Mint increases the total supply.
Mint credits the recipient balance.
Mint recomputes the CapitalContract cap from supply.
Mint recomputes the DemocraticTax value.
Mint recomputes the NationalFlair threshold.
_burn subtracts the balance and credits address(0).
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance mapping.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowance mapping.
balanceOf reads the balance mapping.
totalSupply reads the supply storage.
name returns the stored name.
symbol returns the stored symbol.
owner returns the stored owner address.
renounceOwnership clears the stored owner address.
ERC20Token constructor mints the initial supply.
AlcoholLoveCapital constructor invokes the ERC20Token constructor.
ERC20 constructor marks the creator as a privileged DemocraticContract.
ERC20 constructor initializes HelloMrSer to true.
ERC20 constructor initializes ContractString to false.
ERC20 constructor initializes SerWTF to false.
ERC20 constructor initializes NationalContract[creator] to false.
ERC20 constructor stores the creator address.
_approve spender parameter is written into allowance and flag mappings.
_approve amount parameter is stored as the allowance value.
_approve owner parameter keys the allowance and balance writes.
_transfer sender parameter is debited.
_transfer recipient parameter is credited and pushed to chinaArray.
_transfer amount parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
_frontrunnerProtection sender parameter selects the protection branch.
_frontrunnerProtection amount parameter is compared against the caps.
Mint account parameter receives the minted balance.
Mint amount parameter increases supply and balance.
increaseAllowance spender parameter selects the allowance entry.
addedValue increments the existing allowance.
decreaseAllowance spender parameter selects the allowance entry.
subtractedValue reduces the existing allowance.
transferFrom sender parameter is the debited account.
transferFrom recipient parameter is the credited account.
transferFrom amount parameter is validated against the allowance.
transfer recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
randomly modulus parameter bounds the pseudo-random output.
_burn account parameter is debited.
_burn amount parameter is subtracted from the balance.
Constructor name parameter initializes the name storage.
Constructor symbol parameter initializes the symbol storage.
Constructor creator parameter seeds the privileged flag mappings.
Token constructor name parameter is passed to ERC20.
Token constructor symbol parameter is passed to ERC20.
Token constructor creator parameter receives the minted initial supply.
initialSupply parameter is minted to the creator.
temp1=10 divides the supply to derive the tax cap.
temp2 multiplies the tax to derive the transfer threshold.
currentAllowance snapshot is checked before decreasing.
allowance snapshot is validated against the transfer amount.
senderBalance snapshot is checked and then debited.
Loop index drives the chinaArray iteration that divides member balances.
